properties.disease overview: Chronic retroviral infection causing progressive CD4+ T-cell depletion; untreated progression can lead to AIDS with opportunistic infections and malignancies.
properties.mechanism: Enveloped ssRNA retrovirus. gp120 binds CD4 (and co-receptors), entry/fusion → reverse transcription (RT) → integration into host genome → replication. Immune activation and viral cytopathic effects drive CD4 decline. ARV combination therapy suppresses viral load; U=U when undetectable.
